title: modelfiler
description: load a model file into tables

arguments.description: name of an OBJ file to be loaded (optional)

methods.description: choose which backend to use first to open the model
set tables to write the vertex positions (x, y, z) to
set tables to write the vertex colors to
set tables to write the vertex normals to
set tables to write the texture coordinates to
print available properties (for reading and/or writing)

body: [modelfiler] loads an Alias/Wavefront model file and writes its vertex data into Pd arrays/tables.
